{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distinct values in channel
print("Distinct channels:", df['channel'].unique())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check the first few values of revenue to confirm format
print("Sample of revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())"}
